checkpoints.name: id_persist_fix_and_color_by_id
checkpoints.description: Fixed ID churn: feedback_id input rewired glsl_centroid->glsl_idtrack (feedback now carries previous-frame IDs, so static blobs keep IDs). Color-by-ID: glsl_labelviz gains glsl_idtrack as input1; text_labelviz now hashes the persistent ID at each pixel's root slot instead of the root coordinate. Also added earlier: script_blob_table->out_blob_table per-blob DAT. Verified with synthetic 3-dot source: static IDs persist across frames; out_labels color == hash(id), constant per blob.

checkpoints.name: blobtrack_id_fixed_clean
checkpoints.description: CLEAN fixed state (no cook loop). Feedback fix: feedback_id input=glsl_idtrack AND Target top param CLEARED (the phantom cook-loop was caused by Target=glsl_idtrack while also feeding idtrack). IDs now persist for stationary blobs. Color-by-ID: glsl_labelviz input1=glsl_idtrack, text_labelviz hashes persistent ID at root slot. out_blob_table DAT (id,tx,ty,area,w,h, one row per blob). Verified: static dots keep IDs across frames, no errors, viz color==hash(id).

checkpoints.name: pre_cpu_idtrack
checkpoints.description: Before re-architecting ID association to CPU (script_idtrack scriptTOP) and removing GPU feedback loop (glsl_idtrack/feedback_id). Current: GPU feedback functional but logs cook-loop error every frame.

checkpoints.name: cpu_idtrack_final
checkpoints.description: FINAL clean CPU ID-tracking architecture. script_idtrack (scriptTOP) is sole tracker: reads glsl_centroid, greedy one-to-one nearest match vs prev frame (container storage), outputs (id,cx,cy,valid) texture + stores blob list on container. glsl_labelviz colors by persistent ID (hash of id at root slot). script_blobs + out_blob_table read container storage (no script->script cooked reads -> NO cook loop). GPU glsl_idtrack/feedback_id/feedback_seed removed. Verified: IDs 1,2,3 persist incl moving dot, color==hash(id), zero cook-loop errors, out_blobs/out_blob_table populated.
